why: The opposite half, and the more destructive one: keeps `wasInGameplay` and drops the `!sm.inGameplay` test, so a click that STAYED in gameplay disposes anyway. Resume, Retry, Play Again and Next Level all run the same handler -- so pausing and resuming would tear down the match the player is in the middle of. 1 of 32 -- 'a handler that stays in gameplay disposes nothing', which is the only case that fires a gameplay handler with a gameplay outcome. Paired with the entry above: one per direction, because a single test cannot fail both ways. Re-measured at 2 for issue #279: `only stops a session whose action actually LEFT gameplay` is a new route-host.test.ts case reading the same disposal seam, so it fails here with the rest. One case, not a population shift.
